inclusions: Local sightseeing guide for root bridge

data.title: Gangtok – Darjeeling – Lachung – Pelling Package
data.overview: A majestic tour of Sikkim and North Bengal. Witness the sunrise at Tiger Hill in Darjeeling, explore Gangtok, travel to high-altitude Lachung, and view the Kanchenjunga from Pelling.
data.subtitle: Sikkim & West Bengal Explorer

itinerary.title: Bagdogra/NJP to Darjeeling
itinerary.description: Bagdogra/NJP → Darjeeling. Pick up at airport/station. Scenic drive through tea gardens. Overnight stay in Darjeeling.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Darjeeling sightseeing. Early morning sunrise at Tiger Hill. Later visit Ghoom Monastery, Batasia Loop, and tea gardens.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling to Gangtok
itinerary.description: Darjeeling → Gangtok. Drive to Gangtok (approx. 4 hrs). Evening walk on MG Marg.

itinerary.title: Gangtok to Lachung
itinerary.description: Gangtok → Lachung. Drive to North Sikkim's Lachung. En route waterfalls and valleys. Night in Lachung.

itinerary.title: Lachung to Yumthang to Gangtok
itinerary.description: Lachung → Yumthang → Gangtok. Excursion to Yumthang Valley of Flowers and hot springs. Later drive back to Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Gangtok to Pelling
itinerary.description: Gangtok → Pelling. Drive to Pelling. Visit the Pelling Sky Walk and enjoy panoramic views of Mt. Kanchenjunga.

itinerary.title: Pelling to Bagdogra/NJP Departure
itinerary.description: Pelling → Bagdogra/NJP departure. Breakfast and check-out. Drive back to airport/station.

inclusions: Dedicated private vehicle (4WD for North Sikkim)

data.title: Leh Ladakh Package
data.overview: Witness the unmatched beauty of the Land of High Passes. Discover Leh, magnetic hills, drive through the legendary Khardung La, ride camels in Nubra, and camp by the blue waters of Pangong.
data.subtitle: Leh – Sham Valley – Nubra Valley – Pangong Lake

itinerary.title: Arrival in Leh + Rest & Acclimatization
itinerary.description: Arrival in Leh + rest & acclimatization. Pick up from Leh airport. Full day rest to adapt to high altitude.

itinerary.title: Leh Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Leh local sightseeing. Visit Shanti Stupa, Hall of Fame, and Leh Palace. Overnight stay in Leh.

itinerary.title: Leh to Sham Valley to Leh
itinerary.description: Leh → Sham Valley → Leh. Explore Magnetic Hill, Gurudwara Pathar Sahib, and Indus-Zanskar confluence.

itinerary.title: Leh to Khardung La to Nubra Valley
itinerary.description: Leh → Khardung La → Nubra Valley. Cross Khardung La Pass (5,359m) and descend into Nubra Valley. Double-humped camel riding in Hunder Sand Dunes. Night in Nubra.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Pangong Lake
itinerary.description: Nubra → Pangong Lake. Scenic drive to Pangong Lake via Shyok river route. Sunset walk at the lake.

itinerary.title: Pangong to Chang La to Leh
itinerary.description: Pangong → Chang La → Leh. Witness the sunrise, then drive back to Leh crossing Chang La Pass. Overnight stay in Leh.

itinerary.title: Leh Departure
itinerary.description: Leh departure. Breakfast and check-out. Drop at Leh airport.

data.title: Vaishno Devi – Patnitop Package
data.overview: A highly spiritual and scenic tour taking you to the holy cave shrine of Mata Vaishno Devi in Katra, followed by relaxation amidst the pine forests and parks of Patnitop.
data.subtitle: Holy Darshan & Pine Hill Getaway

itinerary.title: Jammu to Katra + Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Jammu → Katra + local sightseeing. Pick up from Jammu. Drive to Katra (approx. 50 km / 1.5 hrs). Check-in and relax.

itinerary.title: Vaishno Devi Darshan
itinerary.description: Vaishno Devi Darshan. Start the 14 km holy trek (or helicopter ride) to Mata Vaishno Devi Bhawan. Return to Katra for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Katra to Patnitop + Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Katra → Patnitop + sightseeing. Breakfast and drive to Patnitop (approx. 85 km / 2.5 hrs). Visit Pine parks, Naag Temple. Overnight stay in Patnitop.

itinerary.title: Patnitop to Jammu Departure
itinerary.description: Patnitop → Jammu departure. Enjoy morning views at Natha Top. Drive back to Jammu for drop at station/airport.

inclusions: Private vehicle transfers Jammu to Jammu

data.title: Srinagar – Pahalgam – Gulmarg Package
data.overview: A luxurious experience of Kashmir: Mughal Gardens & Dal Lake Shikara ride in Srinagar, pine-forested valleys of Pahalgam, and snow-filled Gondola rides in Gulmarg.
data.subtitle: Classic Valley & Shikara Experience

itinerary.title: Srinagar Arrival + Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Srinagar arrival + local sightseeing. Pick up and check-in at hotel. Evening Shikara ride on Dal Lake. Overnight stay in Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Pahalgam
itinerary.description: Srinagar → Pahalgam. Drive to Pahalgam (approx. 95 km / 3 hrs). Visit Betaab Valley and Chandanwari. Overnight stay in Pahalgam.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam Sightseeing to Srinagar
itinerary.description: Pahalgam sightseeing → Srinagar. Visit Aru Valley, then drive back to Srinagar. Stroll in Mughal Gardens (Shalimar & Nishat).

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Gulmarg + Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Srinagar → Gulmarg + sightseeing. Drive to Gulmarg. Explore the meadow of flowers and take the Gondola ride. Overnight stay in Gulmarg.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg Full-day Sightseeing to Srinagar
itinerary.description: Gulmarg full-day sightseeing → Srinagar. Free day for skiing/snow activities in Gulmarg, then drive back to Srinagar for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Srinagar Sightseeing + Departure
itinerary.description: Srinagar sightseeing + departure. Visit local handicraft markets. Drop at Srinagar airport.

data.title: Spiti Valley Circuit
data.hotels: 1N Shimla · 1N Sarahan · 1N Kalpa · 2N Kaza · 1N Chandratal · 1N Manali
data.overview: Embark on an offbeat high-altitude road trip of a lifetime. Travel through Shimla, Sarahan, Kalpa, Key Monastery in Kaza, and camp under the stars at Chandratal Lake.
data.subtitle: Chandigarh – Shimla – Kalpa – Kaza – Chandratal – Manali

itinerary.title: Chandigarh to Shimla
itinerary.description: Chandigarh → Shimla. Drive to Shimla. Check-in. Overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Shimla to Sarahan
itinerary.description: Shimla → Sarahan. Drive to Sarahan. Visit Bhimakali Temple. Overnight stay in Sarahan.

itinerary.title: Sarahan to Kalpa
itinerary.description: Sarahan → Kalpa. Drive to Kalpa. Panoramic views of Kinnaur Kailash peaks. Overnight stay in Kalpa.

itinerary.title: Kalpa to Nako to Tabo to Kaza
itinerary.description: Kalpa → Nako → Tabo → Kaza. Drive to Kaza. En route visit Nako Lake and 1000-year-old Tabo Monastery. Overnight stay in Kaza.

itinerary.title: Kaza Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Kaza local sightseeing. Visit Key Monastery, Kibber village, and Komic (highest post office). Overnight stay in Kaza.

itinerary.title: Kaza to Chandratal
itinerary.description: Kaza → Chandratal. Drive to Chandratal Lake via Kunzum Pass. Overnight stay in tents at Chandratal.

itinerary.title: Chandratal to Atal Tunnel to Manali
itinerary.description: Chandratal → Atal Tunnel → Manali. Drive to Manali via Atal Tunnel. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali to Chandigarh
itinerary.description: Manali → Chandigarh. Breakfast and drive back to Chandigarh. Trip ends.

data.title: Chandigarh to Amritsar Grand Tour
data.overview: A spectacular cross-state journey through Himachal Pradesh's finest hill stations, ending in the cultural and historical capital of Punjab, Amritsar.
data.subtitle: Shimla – Manali – Dharamshala – Dalhousie – Amritsar

itinerary.title: Chandigarh to Shimla
itinerary.description: Chandigarh → Shimla. Drive to Shimla. Check-in and relax. Evening walk at Mall Road, Ridge, and Christ Church.

itinerary.title: Shimla
itinerary.description: Shimla. Visit Kufri, Green Valley, Jakhoo Temple, and Mall Road. Night stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Shimla to Manali
itinerary.description: Shimla → Manali. Morning departure for Manali. Scenic mountain drive via Mandi/Kullu. Evening free. Night in Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali
itinerary.description: Manali. Explore Solang Valley, Atal Tunnel/Sissu if accessible, Old Manali, and Mall Road. Night in Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali to Dharamshala
itinerary.description: Manali → Dharamshala. Drive to Dharamshala/McLeod Ganj. Evening: McLeod Ganj, Dalai Lama Temple, Bhagsu area. Night in Dharamshala.

itinerary.title: Dharamshala to Dalhousie
itinerary.description: Dharamshala → Dalhousie. Morning sightseeing: Dharamshala/McLeod Ganj. Then drive to Dalhousie. Evening at leisure. Night in Dalhousie.

itinerary.title: Dalhousie to Amritsar
itinerary.description: Dalhousie → Amritsar. Morning Khajjiar excursion (Mini Switzerland), then drive to Amritsar. Evening: Wagah/Attari Border ceremony if timing permits. Night in Amritsar.

itinerary.title: Amritsar
itinerary.description: Amritsar. Golden Temple early morning, Jallianwala Bagh, Partition Museum, local market. Evening at Golden Temple. Night in Amritsar.

itinerary.title: Amritsar
itinerary.description: Amritsar. Breakfast and departure. Trip ends.

inclusions: Dedicated AC Private vehicle for 9 days
All state tolls and driver permits

data.title: Shimla + Manali + Kasol Escape
data.overview: Immerse yourself in Himachal's absolute favorites: the colonial grandeur of Shimla, the adventure slopes of Manali, and the serene riverside pine forests of Kasol in Parvati Valley.
data.subtitle: Hill Stations & Parvati Valley Trail

itinerary.title: Chandigarh to Shimla + Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Chandigarh → Shimla + local sightseeing. Pick up and drive to Shimla. Check-in and relax. Evening walk at Mall Road, Ridge, and Christ Church.

itinerary.title: Shimla + Kufri Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Shimla + Kufri sightseeing. Visit the snow viewpoints of Kufri, Green Valley, Jakhoo Temple, and Mall Road. Overnight in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Shimla to Manali
itinerary.description: Shimla → Manali. Morning departure for Manali. Scenic mountain drive via Mandi and Kullu Valley. Evening free for leisure.

itinerary.title: Manali Local + Solang Valley
itinerary.description: Manali local + Solang Valley. Visit Hadimba Temple, Solang Valley (for adventure activities), and drive through the Atal Tunnel if accessible.

itinerary.title: Manali to Kasol to Manikaran
itinerary.description: Manali → Kasol → Manikaran. Drive to Kasol (Parvati Valley). Visit the sacred hot springs of Manikaran and stroll by the Parvati River.

itinerary.title: Kasol to Chandigarh
itinerary.description: Kasol → Chandigarh. Breakfast and check-out. Drive back to Chandigarh railway station/airport for departure.

highlights: Kasol Pine Forests & Manikaran Hot Springs

data.title: Char Dham Yatra
data.hotels: 2N Barkot · 2N Uttarkashi · 2N Guptkashi · 1N Kedarnath · 1N Joshimath · 1N Rudraprayag · 1N Haridwar
data.overview: A complete, traditional Uttarakhand Char Dham Yatra covering Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, and Badrinath. Ideal for spiritual seekers looking for a structured, safe, and devout pilgrimage.
data.subtitle: Traditional Yamunotri-Gangotri-Kedarnath-Badrinath Yatra

itinerary.title: Haridwar to Barkot
itinerary.description: Haridwar → Barkot. Drive to Barkot (approx. 220 km / 7 hrs) via Mussoorie and Kempty Falls. Overnight stay in Barkot.

itinerary.title: Barkot to Janki Chatti to Yamunotri to Barkot
itinerary.description: Barkot → Janki Chatti → Yamunotri → Barkot. Drive to Janki Chatti, then trek 6 km to Yamunotri Temple. Take a holy dip in Jamunabai Kund and seek blessings. Return to Barkot.

itinerary.title: Barkot to Uttarkashi
itinerary.description: Barkot → Uttarkashi. Drive to Uttarkashi (approx. 100 km / 4 hrs). Visit the historic Vishwanath Temple and Bhagirathi River banks.

itinerary.title: Uttarkashi to Gangotri to Uttarkashi
itinerary.description: Uttarkashi → Gangotri → Uttarkashi. Early morning excursion to Gangotri Temple. Take a holy dip in the Ganges (Bhagirathi) and perform puja. Return to Uttarkashi.

itinerary.title: Uttarkashi to Guptkashi
itinerary.description: Uttarkashi → Guptkashi. Drive to Guptkashi (approx. 220 km / 8 hrs). Check-in at hotel and prepare for the Kedarnath trek.

itinerary.title: Guptkashi to Sonprayag to Kedarnath
itinerary.description: Guptkashi → Sonprayag → Kedarnath. Drive to Sonprayag/Gaurikund, then start the 16 km trek to Kedarnath Temple. Attend the evening temple Aarti. Overnight stay in Kedarnath.

itinerary.title: Kedarnath to Sonprayag to Guptkashi
itinerary.description: Kedarnath → Sonprayag → Guptkashi. Wake up early for morning darshan. Perform return trek back to Gaurikund, and drive back to Guptkashi.

itinerary.title: Guptkashi to Badrinath
itinerary.description: Guptkashi → Badrinath. Drive to Badrinath (approx. 190 km / 7 hrs) via Joshimath. Take a bath in Tapt Kund and attend Badrinath Temple evening Aarti.

itinerary.title: Badrinath Darshan + Mana Village to Joshimath
itinerary.description: Badrinath Darshan + Mana Village → Joshimath. Perform morning darshan. Later visit Mana Village (the last Indian village). Drive to Joshimath.

itinerary.title: Joshimath to Rudraprayag
itinerary.description: Joshimath → Rudraprayag. Visit Narsingh Temple in Joshimath. Drive to Rudraprayag (approx. 115 km / 4.5 hrs) along the Alaknanda River.

itinerary.title: Rudraprayag to Rishikesh/Haridwar
itinerary.description: Rudraprayag → Rishikesh/Haridwar. Drive to Haridwar via Devprayag (confluence of Alaknanda and Bhagirathi) and Rishikesh (Laxman Jhula).

itinerary.title: Haridwar Departure
itinerary.description: Haridwar departure. Breakfast and check-out. Drop at Haridwar railway station or Dehradun airport.

inclusions: Transport in dedicated vehicle for hills

data.title: Nainital + Jim Corbett Itinerary
data.overview: A perfect blend of natural tranquility and wild adventure, taking you from the serene mountain lakes of Nainital to the dense tiger-inhabited forests of Jim Corbett National Park.
data.subtitle: Scenic Lakes & Wilderness Safari

itinerary.title: Delhi to Nainital + Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Delhi → Nainital + local sightseeing. Pick up from Delhi. Drive to Nainital, check-in. Evening walk along Naini Lake and shopping at Mall Road.

itinerary.title: Nainital Full Day Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Nainital full-day sightseeing. Visit lake district (Bhimtal, Sattal, Naukuchiatal), take cable car to Snow View, and visit Hanuman Garhi temple.

itinerary.title: Nainital to Jim Corbett + Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Nainital → Jim Corbett + local sightseeing. Drive to Jim Corbett. Visit Corbett Waterfalls en route, and visit Garjiya Devi Temple.

itinerary.title: Corbett Safari to Delhi
itinerary.description: Corbett Safari → Delhi. Early morning open jeep safari in Corbett National Park. Return for breakfast, check-out, and drive back to Delhi.

data.title: Uttarakhand Tour Package
data.overview: A grand circular tour of Devbhoomi Uttarakhand covering Mussoorie's mountain peaks, Haridwar's holy riverbanks, Jim Corbett's tiger reserve, and the lake district of Nainital.
data.subtitle: Delhi – Mussoorie – Haridwar – Jim Corbett – Nainital

itinerary.title: Delhi to Mussoorie + Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Delhi → Mussoorie + local sightseeing. Morning departure from Delhi. Drive to Mussoorie, check-in, and stroll on the famous Mall Road.

itinerary.title: Mussoorie Full Day Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Mussoorie full-day sightseeing. Visit Kempty Falls, Lake Mist, Company Garden, and enjoy the sunset from Gun Hill.

itinerary.title: Mussoorie to Haridwar + Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Mussoorie → Haridwar + sightseeing. Drive to Haridwar. Visit local temples and experience the magical evening Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri.

itinerary.title: Haridwar to Jim Corbett + Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Haridwar → Jim Corbett + sightseeing. Drive to Jim Corbett National Park. Explore the Corbett Museum and enjoy a resort stay near the forest.

itinerary.title: Corbett Safari to Nainital
itinerary.description: Corbett Safari → Nainital. Enjoy an early morning jungle jeep safari. Later drive to Nainital and enjoy a sunset boat ride on Naini Lake.

itinerary.title: Nainital Sightseeing to Delhi
itinerary.description: Nainital sightseeing → Delhi. Visit Bhimtal, Sattal, and local view points before driving back to Delhi for departure.

data.title: Mussoorie – Rishikesh – Haridwar Package
data.overview: Experience the misty climate of Mussoorie, followed by the yoga and adventure capital Rishikesh, and the sacred Ganga Aarti in Haridwar.
data.subtitle: Queen of Hills & Holy Ganges Tour

itinerary.title: Delhi to Mussoorie + Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Delhi → Mussoorie + local sightseeing. Drive from Delhi (approx. 270 km / 7 hrs). Check-in. Stroll on Mall Road, visit Gun Hill. Overnight in Mussoorie.

itinerary.title: Mussoorie Full Day Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Mussoorie full-day sightseeing. Visit Kempty Falls, Lake Mist, Company Garden, and Lal Tibba. Overnight in Mussoorie.

itinerary.title: Mussoorie to Rishikesh + Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Mussoorie → Rishikesh + sightseeing. Drive to Rishikesh (approx. 80 km / 2.5 hrs). Visit Laxman Jhula, Ram Jhula, Swarg Ashram, and Triveni Ghat. Overnight in Rishikesh.

itinerary.title: Rishikesh to Haridwar
itinerary.description: Rishikesh sightseeing → Haridwar. Transfer to Haridwar. Visit Mansa Devi and Chandi Devi temples. Attend Evening Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri. Overnight in Haridwar.

itinerary.title: Haridwar to Delhi
itinerary.description: Haridwar sightseeing → Delhi. Breakfast and check-out. Drive back to Delhi. Drop at Delhi airport/station.

inclusions: AC Private Transport Delhi to Delhi

data.title: Agra – Mathura – Vrindavan – Gokul – Barsana
data.overview: Dive into the mystical childhood land of Lord Krishna. Cover Vrindavan, Mathura, Gokul, and Barsana while enjoying the beautiful historic sights of Agra.
data.subtitle: Krishna Heritage Tour ex. Agra

itinerary.title: Agra to Mathura & Vrindavan
itinerary.description: Agra → Mathura → Vrindavan. Pick up from Agra, drive to Mathura. Visit Krishna Janmabhoomi, Dwarkadhish temple. Proceed to Vrindavan, visit Prem Mandir. Overnight in Vrindavan.

itinerary.title: Vrindavan, Gokul & Mathura tour
itinerary.description: Vrindavan → Gokul → Mathura → Vrindavan. Visit Gokul (Raman Reti, Brahmand Ghat). Return to Vrindavan to visit Banke Bihari temple, ISKCON temple, and Nidhivan. Overnight in Vrindavan.

itinerary.title: Vrindavan to Barsana to Agra
activities: Keep in mind the Taj Mahal
itinerary.description: Vrindavan → Barsana → Agra. Drive to Barsana (Radha Rani Temple). Return to Agra. Optional visit to Taj Mahal. Drop at Agra station/airport.

data.title: Ayodhya – Prayagraj – Varanasi Package
data.overview: A deep pilgrimage connecting the newly constructed Ram Mandir in Ayodhya, the sacred Sangam in Prayagraj, and the spiritual ghats and temples of Kashi (Varanasi).
data.subtitle: Holy Ganga & Ram Janmabhoomi Tour

itinerary.title: Ayodhya Arrival & Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Ayodhya arrival + local sightseeing. Visit Ram Janmabhoomi Temple, Hanuman Garhi, Kanak Bhawan, and Saryu River Aarti. Overnight in Ayodhya.

itinerary.title: Ayodhya to Prayagraj + Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Ayodhya → Prayagraj + sightseeing. Drive to Prayagraj (approx. 170 km / 4 hrs). Visit Triveni Sangam, Anand Bhawan, and Akbar Fort. Overnight in Prayagraj.

itinerary.title: Prayagraj to Varanasi + Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Prayagraj → Varanasi + sightseeing. Drive to Varanasi (approx. 120 km / 3 hrs). Visit Dashashwamedh Ghat for Ganga Aarti. Overnight in Varanasi.

itinerary.title: Varanasi Sightseeing & Departure
itinerary.description: Varanasi sightseeing + departure. Early morning boat ride on Ganges, visit Kashi Vishwanath temple, Sarnath stupa, and drop at Varanasi airport/station.

inclusions: AC Private transport for entire circuit

data.title: Golden Triangle + Mathura & Vrindavan
data.overview: Experience the Golden Triangle of Delhi, Agra, and Jaipur combined with the spiritual shrines of Mathura and Vrindavan where Lord Krishna was born and raised.
data.subtitle: Delhi – Agra – Mathura – Vrindavan – Jaipur

itinerary.title: Delhi to Agra + Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Delhi → Agra + Agra sightseeing. Check-in at hotel. Visit Taj Mahal and Agra Fort. Overnight in Agra.

itinerary.title: Agra to Mathura to Vrindavan
itinerary.description: Agra → Mathura → Vrindavan. Visit Krishna Janmabhoomi, Dwarkadhish Temple, Prem Mandir and Banke Bihari Temple. Overnight in Vrindavan.

itinerary.title: Vrindavan to Jaipur
itinerary.description: Vrindavan → Jaipur. Drive to Jaipur. Check-in. Evening free for local markets or optional visit to Chokhi Dhani. Overnight in Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Jaipur Full Day Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Jaipur full-day sightseeing. Visit Amer Fort, Hawa Mahal, City Palace, and Jantar Mantar. Overnight in Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Jaipur to Delhi + Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Jaipur → Delhi + Delhi sightseeing. Drive back to Delhi. Visit India Gate, Qutub Minar, and Lotus Temple. Overnight in Delhi.

itinerary.title: Delhi Sightseeing & Departure
itinerary.description: Delhi sightseeing + departure. Morning shopping at Connaught Place/Janpath. Transfer to railway station/airport.

inclusions: AC Private vehicle for all transfers

data.title: Kutch Rann Utsav Package
data.overview: Witness the magnificent white salt desert during the Rann Utsav. Live in premium tents, experience traditional music & dance, and visit the Black Hills and handicraft villages.
data.subtitle: Experience the White Desert Festival

itinerary.title: Arrival at Dhordo – Rann Utsav
itinerary.description: Check-in at Tent City, Dhordo. Welcome ceremony with traditional music & dance. Evening visit to White Rann for sunset view. Enjoy Rann Utsav cultural programs (folk dance, music, handicrafts). Overnight stay at Tent City.

itinerary.title: Excursion & Festival Activities
itinerary.description: Early morning White Rann sunrise view. Breakfast at Tent City. Excursion to Kala Dungar (Black Hill) – panoramic view of the Rann. Visit nearby handicraft villages (Bhujodi, Hodka, Nirona – Rogan art, embroidery, bell making). Evening leisure at Tent City with cultural shows, camel rides, and shopping. Overnight stay at Tent City.

itinerary.title: Departure from Dhordo
itinerary.description: Breakfast and check-out. Optional visit to Bhuj city (Aina Mahal, Prag Mahal, Kutch Museum) if time permits. Departure from Dhordo.

inclusions: All Meals (Breakfast, Lunch, High Tea, Dinner)

data.title: Statue of Unity & Pavagadh
data.overview: Visit the grand 182m Statue of Unity, Sardar Sarovar Dam, and the UNESCO heritage city of Champaner alongside a ropeway pilgrimage to the hilltop temple of Pavagadh.
data.subtitle: Ex-Ahmedabad Monument & Hill Temple Tour

itinerary.title: Ahmedabad to Statue of Unity
itinerary.description: Morning departure from Ahmedabad (approx. 200 km / 4 hrs). Check-in at hotel near Statue of Unity. Visit Statue of Unity (Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel) – viewing gallery, museum, and exhibition. Explore Valley of Flowers, Sardar Sarovar Dam, and Glow Garden (evening). Overnight stay near Statue of Unity.

itinerary.title: Statue of Unity to Pavagadh
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive to Pavagadh (approx. 150 km / 3.5 hrs). Visit Maa Mahakalika Temple (ropeway ride available). Explore Champaner-Pavagadh Archaeological Park (UNESCO World Heritage Site). Evening leisure in Pavagadh. Overnight stay in Pavagadh/Vadodara.

itinerary.title: Pavagadh to Ahmedabad
itinerary.description: Breakfast and check-out. Drive back to Ahmedabad (approx. 150 km / 3.5 hrs). En route visit Vadodara city highlights (Laxmi Vilas Palace, Sayaji Garden – optional). Drop at Ahmedabad railway station/airport.

inclusions: AC Private vehicle for transfers & sightseeing

data.title: Dwarka – Somnath – Diu – Sasan Gir
data.overview: A complete experience of Gujarat bringing together the holy shrines of Dwarka and Somnath, the serene tropical beaches of Diu, and the thrilling Asiatic Lion safari of Sasan Gir.
data.subtitle: Spiritual, Wildlife & Beach Gateway

itinerary.title: Arrival at Dwarka
itinerary.description: Check-in at hotel. Evening Dwarkadhish Temple Aarti. Overnight stay in Dwarka.

itinerary.title: Dwarka Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Dwarkadhish Temple. Excursion to Bet Dwarka Island (by ferry). Visit Nageshwar Jyotirlinga, Rukmini Temple, and Gopi Talav. Evening leisure at Dwarka Beach. Overnight stay in Dwarka.

itinerary.title: Dwarka to Somnath
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive to Somnath (approx. 230 km / 5 hrs). Visit Somnath Jyotirlinga Temple, Bhalka Tirth, and Triveni Sangam. Evening Sound & Light Show at Somnath Temple. Overnight stay in Somnath.

itinerary.title: Somnath to Diu
itinerary.description: Morning departure to Diu (approx. 90 km / 2 hrs). Explore Diu Fort, St. Paul’s Church, Naida Caves. Relax at Nagoa Beach. Overnight stay in Diu.

itinerary.title: Diu to Sasan Gir
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive to Gir National Park (approx. 65 km / 1.5 hrs). Afternoon Gir Jungle Safari (permit required). Visit Devaliya Safari Park for a shorter wildlife experience. Overnight stay near Sasan Gir.

itinerary.title: Sasan Gir to Dwarka (Departure)
itinerary.description: Breakfast and check-out. Drive back to Dwarka/departure point.

inclusions: All private transfers in AC vehicle

data.title: Somnath – Dwarka – Porbandar Package
data.overview: Embark on a sacred journey through Dwarka, Somnath, and Porbandar. Visit the highly revered Dwarkadhish temple, Somnath Jyotirlinga, and the birthplace of Mahatma Gandhi at Porbandar.
data.subtitle: Ex-Rajkot Pilgrimage & Coastal Tour

itinerary.title: Rajkot to Somnath
itinerary.description: Morning departure from Rajkot (approx. 200 km / 4.5 hrs). Check-in at hotel in Somnath. Visit Somnath Jyotirlinga Temple, Bhalka Tirth, and Triveni Sangam. Evening Sound & Light Show at Somnath Temple. Overnight stay in Somnath.

itinerary.title: Somnath to Porbandar to Dwarka
itinerary.description: Early breakfast, drive to Porbandar (approx. 130 km / 3 hrs). Visit Kirti Mandir (Mahatma Gandhi’s birthplace) and Sudama Temple. Continue to Dwarka (approx. 100 km / 2 hrs). Evening Dwarkadhish Temple Aarti. Overnight stay in Dwarka.

itinerary.title: Dwarka Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Dwarkadhish Temple. Excursion to Bet Dwarka Island (by ferry). Visit Nageshwar Jyotirlinga, Rukmini Temple, and Gopi Talav. Evening leisure at Dwarka Beach. Overnight stay in Dwarka.

itinerary.title: Dwarka to Rajkot
itinerary.description: Breakfast and check-out. Drive back to Rajkot (approx. 230 km / 5 hrs). En route visit Jamnagar Bala Hanuman Temple (famous for continuous Ram Dhun chanting). Drop at Rajkot railway station/airport.
